_note: Built-in personal-assistant preset — for long-lived assistants that must keep a user's durable facts and preferences current across sessions. Enable with VAYL_SLOT_SCHEMA=preset:assistant. Optionally VAYL_CRITICAL_CATEGORIES=critical so dietary restrictions / allergies are always surfaced before the assistant suggests food or places. Nothing is confirm-gated (personal, low-stakes, applies immediately). Identity and settings are single-valued (a change supersedes the old value — a move to a new city retires the old one); preferences, goals, people, dates, and projects are lists.

slots.name: user_name
slots.description: how the user wants to be addressed

slots.name: location
slots.description: where the user is based (city / region)

slots.name: preferred_language
slots.description: the language the user prefers to communicate in

slots.name: communication_style
slots.description: how the user likes responses (e.g. concise, detailed, formal, casual, no emoji)

slots.name: employer
slots.description: the user's current employer or company

slots.name: role
slots.description: the user's current job title or role

slots.name: dietary_restriction
slots.description: a food the user must or chooses to avoid, including allergies (a user may have several)

slots.name: preference
slots.description: a stated personal preference (a user has many)

slots.name: goal
slots.description: a goal the user is working toward (a user may have several)

slots.name: important_date
slots.description: a date that matters to the user (birthday, anniversary, deadline) — several

slots.name: contact
slots.description: a person in the user's life and their relationship (e.g. 'Sam — manager') — several

slots.name: interest
slots.description: a hobby or topic the user is interested in (a user has many)

slots.name: current_project
slots.description: an ongoing project or task the user is working on (a user may have several)
